tool_input.description: Probe the ambiguous matching method scenario

result: Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/reflect/MethodUtilsAgentTest.java` with 44 self-contained test methods covering `MethodUtils`: accessible-method resolution (including non-public classes implementing public interfaces), matching-method/accessible-method lookup with varargs and ambiguity detection, `getMethodObject`, annotation lookup/search-supers, override hierarchies, and all `invokeMethod`/`invokeStaticMethod`/`invokeExactMethod`/`invokeExactStaticMethod` variants — including error paths (`NoSuchMethodException`, `NullPointerException`, `IllegalArgumentException`, `IllegalStateException`, wrapped checked exceptions). All 44 tests pass via `./_tools/test.sh`.
